# Disruption Joe

Disruption Joe helps talented groups accomplish more through focused, carefully structured working sessions.

Core proposition:

One Hour. Real Progress.

Joe helps sponsors find the conversation worth having, identify who needs to be part of it, and understand what has kept prior attempts from moving the work forward. He brings broad experience across companies, operations, product, marketing, growth, leadership, AI adoption, and consortium governance.

Joe has spent ten years developing and refining a playbook of time-boxed exercises informed by Google's Design Sprint, Atlassian's Team Playbook, Liberating Structures, and his experience in technology, product, leadership, and business. He selects, sequences, and adapts those structures so a capable group can surface its strongest thinking, make a decision or meaningful next move, and build the understanding and ownership that support follow-through.

The work may help a group develop clearer understanding, stronger alternatives, more useful decisions, credible commitments, and meaningful progress. It does not make every decision democratic and it does not replace the authority of the people accountable for the decision.

Visitors may begin with one free 30-minute discovery call. If a focused session is appropriate, Joe prepares and personally facilitates a customized one-hour session. A larger consulting commitment is not required to begin, and Joe will say when a challenge needs something different.

Individual facilitated sessions are $20, $50, $100, and $200 for the first four sessions, then $400 per hour. Established clients may also prepay for a flexible 10-hour balance at $3,000 or a 40-hour balance at $10,000. These are balances of Joe's professional time, not predefined workshop packages or self-service purchases.

Each floor contains rooms organized around recognizable challenges. Visitors can collect challenges and send them as context for a discovery call. The website does not diagnose, score, or automatically recommend a consulting program.

Better AI preserves five established conversation paths: Identify the Floor, Establish the Floor, Raise the Floor, Lead the Change, and Push the Frontier. AI is one important application of Thinking Better Together, not a separate business or the definition of all of Joe's work.

The Thinking Museum at /thinking is a separate exploratory experience for Joe's ideas, methods, experiments, and broader body of work.
